source_quality.interpretation: The upstream feed has no documented monotonic sequence field. Current-book freshness and REST comparisons describe observed state; they cannot prove event completeness.

secondary_comparison.assessment_count_scope: current_collector_process; full archive totals require a durable-history audit

lineage.interpretation: A REST/WebSocket mismatch at stable local lineage does not establish which view is incomplete when the upstream feed has no sequence guarantee.

recorded_gaps.scope: Durable local gap markers and reported reason counts. A marker records an observed resynchronization or interruption; it does not establish the number of missing upstream events.

interpretations.duplicate_event_hashes_recent_window: Repeated frame hashes within the bounded recent observation window. The raw records remain stored and are applied idempotently; they are not dropped.
interpretations.timestamp_regressions: A source timestamp earlier than prior local state. The collector invalidates and resynchronizes the affected book; without upstream sequence numbers this does not prove a missing event.
interpretations.snapshot_divergences: A full-depth resynchronization or refresh snapshot differed from the prior local depth state. Markets can change between observations, so this count alone does not prove local event loss.
interpretations.snapshot_source_time_regressions_after_g: A replacement snapshot had an earlier source timestamp after a recorded gap. It is retained as timing uncertainty until later observations establish a newer local state.

event_integrity_signals.count_scope: current_collector_process; counters reset when the collector starts
event_integrity_signals.scope: Local reconstruction counters. Repeated hashes are counted within a bounded recent window; timestamp regressions are source-time checks, not provider sequence proof.
